Name: Fertilizer Bubbles
Author: temisthem
Description:
[b][size=4]Display a bubble over unfertilized soil when holding fertilizer!

Or just toggle the display using a keybinding!

*No guarantees that this'll stop you from continuing to squint at soil
[/size][/b]
[size=3]I missed a tile of soil when I was fertilizing my greenhouse even though I swear I checked it like 3 times. Never again will I be a fool.

No, this doesn't include tree fertilizer.

You can also enable this for seeds in the config!

[b][size=6]Requirements:[/size]
[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)

[size=6][b]Mod Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
Works with basically anything and everything. Including modded fertilizer, assuming that they include the "fertilizer_item" or "quality_fertilizer_item" context tags.

[size=6][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
Only displays for those who have it installed.

[b][size=6]Configuration:[/size]
[/b]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
Customizable settings include:
- Automatically displaying emote when fertilizer is held
- Keybinding for toggling display
- Hide emote when currently held fertilizer cannot be used on a soil tile
- Bubble size, opacity, and offsets 
[/size]
